title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.

providers.name: Microsoft Azure
providers.scope_notes: Covers Microsoft Azure (Azure Storage, Azure Resource Manager, Microsoft Entra Workload ID, Azure DevOps Services). Azure Storage and ARM controls are per subscription/account; Conditional Access for workload identities needs Workload Identities Premium; Azure DevOps PAT policies need an Entra-backed organization. Entra delegated/app-only OAuth for Graph and managed identities are covered by the separate microsoft platform.

controls.name: Restrict global personal access token creation
controls.what: New PATs must target specific organizations.

controls.name: Restrict full-scoped personal access token creation
controls.what: New PATs must use custom scopes.

controls.name: Enforce maximum personal access token lifespan
controls.what: Caps lifetime of new or renewed PATs in days.

controls.name: Restrict personal access token creation
controls.what: Only allowlisted users (or packaging-only) can create or regenerate PATs; existing PATs keep working.

controls.name: Automatically revoke leaked personal access tokens
controls.what: PATs found in public GitHub repos are revoked automatically.

controls.name: Enable IP Conditional Access policy validation on non-interactive flows
controls.what: Checks Entra IP-based Conditional Access on PAT REST calls.

controls.name: Token Admin revoke authorizations
controls.what: Admins revoke users' PATs by authorization ID; disabling a user also revokes their PATs.

no_control.what: PAT use (token access) is not recorded in the Azure DevOps audit log.

controls_unknown: Whether Azure Activity Log records the service principal identity for ARM read calls made with azure-3/azure-4 tokens (Activity log typically skips reads).

authentication.summary: User-owned token for Azure DevOps REST, Git and package feeds; scoped to one organization (global PATs stop working Dec 1, 2026) and limited to the owner's permissions.

federation.details: PATs must meet Entra sign-in policies on REST calls; IP-based Conditional Access is checked on PAT calls only if the org enables "IP Conditional Access policy validation on non-interactive flows".

ip_restriction.boundary: Enforced on PAT REST calls only with the org policy enabled and an Entra IP-based Conditional Access policy.

lifetime.summary: Expiry chosen at creation; tenant max-lifespan policy; becomes inactive if owner does not sign in within 90 days (Entra-backed orgs)

renewal.summary: Reused until expiry; regenerating issues a new value and invalidates the old one.

administration.summary: Tenant policies: restrict global PATs, restrict full-scoped PATs, max lifespan, auto-revoke leaked PATs (on by default). Org policy: restrict PAT creation with allowlist. Admins can revoke users' PATs via Token Admin API.
administration.conditions: Policies require an Entra-backed organization; restricting creation does not stop existing PATs.

sso.details: Conditional Access MFA applies to web flows only; IP-based policies apply to PAT REST calls only if the org enables IP Conditional Access policy validation on non-interactive flows.

offboard.details: PATs stop working when the account is disabled or removed (up to one hour delay), but are not deleted and work again if access is restored.

inventory.details: Project Collection Administrators can list PATs per user with GET .../_apis/tokenadmin/personalaccesstokens/{subjectDescriptor}; no single org-wide list.

sso.ui: dev.azure.com/{org} > Organization settings > Policies > Enable IP Conditional Access policy validation on non-interactive flows = On

usage.ui: Organization settings > Policies > Log Audit Events = On; then Organization settings > Auditing (PAT create/modify/revoke events; docs say token access events are not logged)

offboard.ui: Organization settings > Users > ... > Remove from organization

log_sources.name: Azure DevOps audit log
log_sources.notes: Off by default; 90-day retention, not configurable; export or stream for longer.

credential_id_fields.notes: Token events name the PAT and owner.

containment.steps: Owner revokes in user settings; admins revoke via Token Admin API or disable the user.
containment.notes: Up to 1 h delay for admin revocation; established connections may persist.

use_not_logged.notes: Azure DevOps audit log records PAT create, change and revoke, not each use: "Token access events aren't currently logged."

calls.log_notes: Token access events are not logged.
Repo reads are not listed as audit events on fetched pages.
Audit log Token area says token access events aren't logged; Git area covers repository create/modify/delete, not reads.
